label: Открыть
description: A 10-sentence conjugation card for открыть (to open).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Perfective future, first-person. 'Открою' is the я-form of perfective открыть, built on the stem откро-, and carries future meaning. The imperfective partner is открывать.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, second-person. 'Откроешь' takes the -ешь ending on stem откро-. As a perfective, it marks a single completed act of opening.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, third-person reflexive. 'Откроется' is the reflexive form meaning the shop itself will open. Without -ся, открыть needs a direct object.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, first-person plural. 'Откроем' shows the мы-form ending -ем on stem откро-. 'Весной' frames a single planned opening.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, third-person plural. 'Откроют' is the они-form with the -ют ending. Being perfective, it points to a finished act of opening the exhibition.
Strategic focus: Masculine past tense. 'Открыл' is the masculine singular past of perfective открыть. It reports a single completed act of opening the book.
Strategic focus: Feminine past tense. 'Открыла' adds the feminine -а ending. 'С радостью' colours the single completed act of opening the gift.

missions.phrase: Они открыли все окна в доме.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Plural past tense. 'Открыли' is the plural past form ending in -и. It states that the whole group opened every window.
Strategic focus: Singular imperative. 'Открой' is the informal command of perfective открыть. 'Пожалуйста' softens a direct request to one person.

missions.phrase: Мне нужно открыть новый счёт в банке.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Modal infinitive use. 'Нужно' takes the bare infinitive 'открыть', the perfective form. The sentence expresses a concrete need to open one bank account.
